services.name: Kickboxing
services.desc: Build strength, improve fitness, and relieve stress with our high-energy kickboxing classes led by Master Marco Rosales. Whether you're a beginner or experienced, every workout is designed to challenge and motivate you in a fun, supportive environment. Unlike our Taekwondo membership, Kickboxing is available through flexible class passes-no monthly commitment required. Train when it fits your schedule and enjoy an effective full-body

services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Our summer Taekwondo camp is an intensive taekwondo training program designed to help students rapidly improve their skills and boost their motivation. During the camp, participants will engage in a variety of activities, including exercise, basic forms, poomsae, kicking, breaking, and Taekwondo dance. This camp is open to all our members aged 5 and up, providing a fantastic opportunity for focused, short-term improvement in a fun and supportive environment.
